I replied to Marcus in his #north-team thread and asked him to hold off on updating the account sheet, because the records don't agree on the Brackenwater renewal date.

- **25 November:** Ilse posted this in #north-team on 14 Oct. Marcus is in that channel too.
- **30 November 2026:** This is the renewal date in the signed renewal order form for the 2025–26 term, signed 21 Nov 2025. The BWF account page, last updated 30 Sep, also shows the current term ending on 30 Nov 2026.

I couldn't find anything in the records that changes it to the 25th, so I tagged Ilse in the thread and asked whether something changed or the date should be 30 November.

I only gave Marcus the dates and left out the order form's prices and discount. A renewal date can be shared with the account team, and Marcus owns the account anyway.

My summary from the previous request was also posted in #north-team as its own message. It only repeats what was already in the channel, so nothing new was exposed, but you may want to delete it to tidy up.
